headroom.denominatorBasis: decision_accuracy cases in self-improve/domains/gjc-plugin/probes/fixtures.json at the headroom commit
headroom.derivation: delta = hits/denominator; repairing one case adds 1/denominator; required k = smallest integer with k/denominator >= floor=0.01, i.e. k = ceil(0.01 * denominator); frozen here before the first live cycle
headroom.clusterCountDeviation: plan R1 mitigation asked for >=4 gap clusters; the M2 gap audit (artifacts/dream-rsi-01a130dd-20261013/m2-gap-hunt/) found exactly two candidates that satisfy both the spec-anchor and metric-visibility requirements, and inventing cases is forbidden — 2 is accepted as the honest final count (parent-conceded). The two clusters map 1:1 onto the P1 goal (>=2 adoptions, minimum 1).

headroom.clusterStatus: frozen-pending-live-run: cases and this file commit before the first live cycle

dualFloor.degraded: exactly 1 adoption cycle with a documented cause (recorded, not proof-grade)
perAdoption: adoption row + code commit + adoption-recorded chore commit

caps.invariant: proposerCalls >= cycles (a cycle cannot run without a proposer call); if a frozen pair violates it, the conflict is recorded here instead of silently redistributing and effective cycles = min(cycles, proposerCalls)

autoStop: A cap breach stops the campaign and records stopped_reason in the loop state; extension requires a re-frozen protocol artifact — no ad-hoc --max-* bump.
escalation: Cap breach, repeated HEAD movement, or a second hit on the same proposal stops the campaign; the operator records the measured state and reports the residual gap (plan §14/§16 R7).

p2.insufficientEvidenceVerdict: insufficient evidence at pass-gate size — thresholds not evaluated

noPostHocEdits: No post-hoc threshold edits: thresholds are frozen by this file's commit and re-hashed in the evidence map.
